title: The Lotus Sutra, Part 1
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett invites the audience to participate in a guided meditation, imagining themselves on a mountaintop with the Buddha and other bodhisattvas, where they can feel a sense of deep peace, compassion, and connection. As the meditation progresses, the scene shifts to a Hatsu ceremony, where flowers fall from the sky and the earth moves, but Nomon remains calm and present. The goal of the meditation is not to achieve a specific state, but to cultivate a sense of groundedness and release, allowing the audience to feel more settled and connected to the Dharma.
topics: Great Vehicle Sutra of Innumerable Meanings
